repos_data.description: The trust and intelligence layer between AI agents and your database. Read-only by architecture, semantic knowledge graph + audit log, MCP-native.
Open-source observability and audit trail platform for AI agents. MCP-native, tamper-evident event logging, real-time dashboard.
Claude Code plugin — AI-powered autopilot for managing open source contributions. Track PRs, respond to maintainers, discover issues, maintain velocity.

Tamper-evident audit log for Go: an append-only, hash-chained, optionally Ed25519-signed log/slog handler, with offline logx verify. Built on the standard library, zero third-party dependencies. Also a full slog toolkit (colored output, JSON, rotation, fan-out, CLI).
Give each AI agent its own isolated machine with root, Docker, and systemd. Active defense detects and stops threats automatically.
Download mirror for the Proofpane MCP daemon. Source stays in the private codebase; this exists so browsers (Chrome Safe Browsing, Edge SmartScreen) trust the download.
The approval and accountability layer for agentic AI. Identity → Policy → Approval → Trace. Try: npx sidclaw-demo

world-model-mcp is a signed audit memory server for AI coding agents, delivered as an MCP tool. Every event Ed25519-signed and Merkle-chained; offline-verifiable against pinned public keys. Hosted platform with hybrid post-quantum signing at etch.systems.
Run DeepSeek as a real sub-agent inside Claude Code / Codex CLI — DeepSeek gets its own 7-tool agent loop in a sandboxed workspace, not just a single LLM call.
Open-source runtime security and governance for AI agents, MCP tools, robotics, industrial automation, and physical AI.
Your AI assistant reads CLAUDE.md and ignores it anyway. Ārai makes instruction files enforced — hooks that block, a tamper-evident audit trail, per-rule compliance stats.

repo_meta_data.description: An AI that administers Linux through typed, approval-gated, Ed25519-audited actions. The model selects the action; the daemon builds the command.
